classification: synthetic CPU method qualification; no route experiment
data_model: paired route latencies share within-session regime and common AR(1) workload; route-B minus route-A has a null mean, independent session treatment heterogeneity, and AR(1) residual; independent 5% censoring sets both observed route outcomes to the frozen deadline penalty
